Validate and re-emit foreign TSI JSONL

Usage: ryi-server ingest [OPTIONS] <PATH>...

Arguments:
  <PATH>...  TSI JSONL files (/dev/stdin reads standard input)

Options:
      --sqlite <PATH>  Write to a new SQLite database instead of stdout
      --fresh          Run without the resident daemon (server mode is already fresh)
  -h, --help           Print help
